Replace parent-directory links with marketplace-safe references or package the referenced guidance inside the skill bundle.

content.value_statement: SEO and GEO performance reporting can miss changes when data sits across tools. This skill structures reports and alert rules for traffic, rankings, authority, content, backlinks, and AI visibility.
actual_capabilities: Builds period-over-period SEO and GEO performance report outlines.
Defines report sections for traffic, rankings, authority, backlinks, content, and AI visibility.
Configures alert rules with thresholds, priorities, routing, and response plans.
Labels metrics as measured, user-provided, estimated, or not yet evaluated.
Creates handoff summaries for monitoring memory after user approval.
limitations: Does not fetch analytics, ranking, or Search Console data without connected tools or user exports.
Does not compute CORE-EEAT or CITE scores by itself.
Does not replace a raw position-by-position rank tracker.
Estimated thresholds need validation against real baselines.

use_cases.description: Prepare a concise performance report with wins, risks, KPIs, and next actions for leadership review.

use_cases.description: Create alert thresholds, response times, and routing for keywords, traffic, technical health, and backlinks.

use_cases.title: GEO Visibility Monitoring
use_cases.description: Track AI citations, citation rate, and topic coverage as part of a recurring search visibility workflow.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly SEO report for a SaaS site using exported analytics and ranking data.
output: Executive summary with overall status, wins, risks, and action requests.
Metric table comparing traffic, rankings, conversions, authority, backlinks, and AI citations.
Prioritized next actions with owner, expected impact, and follow-up period.

output_examples.input: Set alerts for organic traffic, top keywords, technical issues, backlinks, and AI citations.
output: Alert matrix with warning and critical thresholds tied to stated baselines.
Response plan for each priority level, including timing, owner, and first checks.
Delivery routing with cooldowns, escalation paths, and weekly review cadence.

best_practices: Provide the domain, reporting period, comparison period, data source, and data freshness.
Use measured or exported data before accepting estimated benchmarks.
Confirm alert baselines and delivery routing before activating response plans.
anti_patterns: Do not treat missing data as a measured decline.
Do not use arbitrary alert thresholds without a baseline.
Do not use this skill for raw keyword position histories.

faq.question: Does this skill collect analytics data automatically?
faq.answer: No. It uses connected tools or user-provided exports when available.

faq.question: Can it create both reports and alerts?
faq.answer: Yes. Report mode summarizes past performance, and alert mode defines future monitoring rules.

faq.question: Does it calculate content quality scores?
faq.answer: No. It can report existing CORE-EEAT results, but it does not compute those scores.

faq.question: How should missing metrics be handled?
faq.answer: Mark missing sections as not yet evaluated and continue with available evidence.

faq.question: Can alerts use default thresholds?
faq.answer: Yes, but default thresholds should be labeled estimated until real baseline data is available.

faq.question: Is it suitable for client reporting?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes audience templates for executive, marketing, technical, and client-facing reports.
